blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Chapter Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈659〉 包裝系統的完整定義體系，包含初級、次級、三級包裝的層級關係
blocks.en: Understand the complete definition framework for packaging systems in USP <659>, including the hierarchy of primary, secondary and tertiary packaging

blocks.zh: 掌握注射劑包裝系統的分類：Multiple-dose、Single-dose、Pharmacy bulk package 的定義與限制
blocks.en: Master the classification of injection packaging systems: the definitions and limits of multiple-dose, single-dose and pharmacy bulk package

blocks.zh: 區分非注射劑包裝分類：Multiple-unit、Single-unit、Unit-dose、Unit-of-use 容器
blocks.en: Distinguish the noninjection packaging classes: multiple-unit, single-unit, unit-dose and unit-of-use containers

blocks.zh: 熟悉各類貯存溫度定義（冷凍、冷藏、冷、涼、室溫、受控室溫）及 MKT 的應用條件
blocks.en: Know the storage temperature definitions (freezer, refrigerator, cold, cool, room temperature, controlled room temperature) and the conditions for applying MKT

blocks.zh: 了解防毒包裝法（PPPA）的適用範圍與豁免情形
blocks.en: Understand the scope of the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA) and its exemptions

blocks.zh: 掌握 Hermetic、Tight、Well-closed、Light-resistant 容器的定義差異
blocks.en: Master the differences among hermetic, tight, well-closed and light-resistant containers

blocks.en: Section 1: Introduction & General Packaging Requirements

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: USP 〈659〉 是整個 USP-NF 包裝要求體系的基礎章節。它確立了兩大核心原則：
blocks.en: USP <659> is the foundation chapter of the entire USP-NF packaging requirements framework. It establishes two core principles:

blocks.zh: 相容性原則：包裝材料不得與藥品發生物理或化學互作，損及其安全性（safety）、特性（identity）、效價（strength）、品質（quality）或純度（purity）——即 SIQOP 五要素
blocks.en: Compatibility principle: packaging materials must not interact physically or chemically with the drug product in a way that alters its safety, identity, strength, quality or purity (the five SIQOP elements)

blocks.zh: 合規連結原則：〈659〉 本身是索引章節，需配合 〈660〉、〈661〉、〈661.1〉、〈661.2〉、〈670〉、〈381〉 等各子章節共同執行
blocks.en: Compliance linkage principle: <659> is itself an index chapter and must be applied together with its related chapters, such as <660>, <661>, <661.1>, <661.2>, <670> and <381>

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把包裝想成藥品的「防護盔甲」：〈659〉 規定了這套盔甲不能傷害穿著者（藥品），各個子章節（〈660〉玻璃、〈661〉塑料、〈381〉彈性體）則規定每種材料的具體標準。缺少任何一層，盔甲就不完整。
blocks.en: Think of packaging as the drug product's "protective armor": <659> states that the armor must not harm its wearer (the drug product), while the individual related chapters (<660> glass, <661> plastics, <381> elastomeric components) set the specific standards for each material. If any layer is missing, the armor is incomplete.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 2025年12月更新：〈661.1〉（Plastic Materials of Construction）和 〈661.2〉（Plastic Packaging Systems for Pharmaceutical Use）於2025年12月1日正式生效，允許提前採納。API（原料藥）預設使用 tight container，輔料（excipient）因大量包裝預設使用 well-closed container。
blocks.en: December 2025 update: <661.1> (Plastic Materials of Construction) and <661.2> (Plastic Packaging Systems for Pharmaceutical Use) became official on December 1, 2025, with early adoption permitted. By default, an API uses a tight container, and an excipient, because it is packaged in bulk, uses a well-closed container.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一種注射用凍乾製劑，包裝材料為玻璃瓶＋橡膠塞，需符合哪些 USP 章節的要求？
blocks.en: A lyophilized injectable is packaged in a glass vial with a rubber stopper. Which USP chapters' requirements must it meet?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「不與藥品互作」是包裝材料最基本的要求？舉一個違反此原則的實例。
blocks.en: Why is "must not interact with the drug product" the most fundamental requirement for packaging materials? Give a real example of a violation of this principle.

blocks.zh: Section 2: Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA) Section 2: 防毒品包裝法（PPPA）
blocks.en: Section 2: Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA)

blocks.zh: 防毒包裝法（Poison Prevention Packaging Act, PPPA）由美國消費者產品安全委員會（CPSC）執行，要求「兒童防護包裝（Child-resistant packaging）」。適用範圍：
blocks.en: The Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA) is enforced by the US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) and requires child-resistant packaging. It applies to:

blocks.zh: 口服處方藥、管制藥品
blocks.en: Oral prescription drugs and controlled substances

blocks.zh: 部分非口服處方藥
blocks.en: Some non-oral prescription drugs

blocks.zh: 部分膳食補充品
blocks.en: Some dietary supplements

blocks.zh: 多種 OTC 藥品
blocks.en: Many OTC drug products

blocks.zh: 豁免情形：住院用藥、大宗包裝供藥師分裝、病患或處方者要求時。
blocks.en: Exemptions: drugs for hospitalized patients, bulk packages from which pharmacists repackage, and cases where the patient or prescriber requests otherwise.

blocks.zh: 兒童防護包裝就像汽車的安全氣囊——平常不妨礙使用，危急時提供保護。成人患者（尤其老年人）若開啟困難，可依法要求「非兒童防護包裝」，體現了安全與便利之間的平衡設計。
blocks.en: Child-resistant packaging is like a car's airbag: it does not get in the way in normal use and provides protection in an emergency. Adult patients (especially the elderly) who find it hard to open can request "non-child-resistant packaging" as permitted by law, which reflects a design balance between safety and convenience.

blocks.zh: OTC 廠商可提供一個規格的非兒童防護包裝，但前提是同時供應兒童防護的「熱門規格」包裝。非兒童防護包裝必須有特殊標示。醫院住院藥品因由醫護人員管理，無需兒童防護包裝。
blocks.en: An OTC manufacturer may supply one size in non-child-resistant packaging, provided that the popular size is also supplied in child-resistant packaging. Non-child-resistant packaging must carry special labeling. Hospital inpatient drugs need no child-resistant packaging because they are administered by medical staff.

blocks.zh: 哪些情況下，PPPA 規範的藥品可以不使用兒童防護包裝？列出至少三種情形。
blocks.en: Under what circumstances may a drug product regulated by the PPPA be supplied without child-resistant packaging? List at least three.

blocks.zh: 某 OTC 止痛藥廠商想推出一款老年友善包裝，在法規上需要滿足什麼條件？
blocks.en: An OTC analgesic manufacturer wants to launch an elderly-friendly package. What regulatory conditions must it meet?

blocks.zh: Section 3: General Definitions — Packaging Section 3: 一般定義 — 包裝
blocks.en: Section 3: General Definitions: Packaging

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 包裝層級體系
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Packaging Hierarchy

blocks.zh: USP 〈659〉 建立了五層包裝結構：
blocks.en: USP <659> establishes a five-level packaging structure:

blocks.zh: 初級（Primary）：直接接觸藥品，如玻璃安瓶、注射瓶、橡膠塞
blocks.en: Primary: in direct contact with the drug product, such as glass ampuls, injection vials and rubber stoppers

blocks.zh: 次級（Secondary）：接觸初級包裝，如外盒、泡殼（blister foil）
blocks.en: Secondary: in contact with the primary packaging, such as outer cartons and blister foil

blocks.zh: 三級（Tertiary）：接觸次級包裝，如紙箱、托盤
blocks.en: Tertiary: in contact with the secondary packaging, such as shipping cartons and trays

blocks.zh: Ancillary（輔助）：接觸三級包裝，如棧板、收縮膜
blocks.en: Ancillary: in contact with the tertiary packaging, such as pallets and shrink wrap

blocks.zh: Associated（附件）：給藥用但非全程儲存，如量杯、口服注射器
blocks.en: Associated: used for administering the drug but not for storage throughout its life, such as dosing cups and oral syringes

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 容器防護等級
blocks.en: Analogy: Container Protection Levels

blocks.zh: 把四種容器類型想像成不同防水等級的建築：
blocks.en: Imagine the four container types as buildings with different levels of weatherproofing:

blocks.zh: Hermetic（密封容器）：完全防水防氣的潛水艇——連空氣都不透
blocks.en: Hermetic: a fully sealed submarine, impervious even to air

blocks.zh: Tight（密封容器）：防水防塵防蒸氣的高山登山帳——防液體、固體、蒸氣
blocks.en: Tight: a mountaineering tent that keeps out water, dust and vapor, protecting against liquids, solids and vapors

blocks.zh: Well-closed（密閉容器）：普通房屋——防外來固體污染與內容物損失，但不需防蒸氣
blocks.en: Well-closed: an ordinary house, which protects against extraneous solids and loss of contents but need not keep out vapor

blocks.zh: Light-resistant（遮光容器）：有遮光設計的房間——主要功能是遮光保護
blocks.en: Light-resistant: a room designed to block light, whose main function is protection from light

blocks.zh: 防護強度：Hermetic > Tight > Well-closed；Light-resistant 是獨立光保護屬性，可與任一類型組合。
blocks.en: Level of protection: hermetic > tight > well-closed. Light-resistant is an independent light-protection attribute that can be combined with any of the types.

blocks.zh: Small vs. Large Volume Parenteral：SVP（≤100 mL）vs. LVP（>100 mL），這個區分在產品開發、法規申報和生產分類上非常重要。注射劑的所有包裝均需確認 Container–closure integrity（容器密封完整性），參見 〈1207〉 系列章節。
blocks.en: Small vs. Large Volume Parenteral: SVP (≤100 mL) vs. LVP (>100 mL). This distinction matters greatly in product development, regulatory filing and manufacturing classification. All injection packaging must be confirmed for container-closure integrity; see the <1207> series of chapters.

blocks.zh: Tight container 特殊規定：當規格要求使用 tight container 時，單劑量製品可以改用 hermetic container 替代。
blocks.en: Special provision for tight containers: where a monograph or specification calls for a tight container, a hermetic container may be used instead for a single-dose product.

blocks.zh: 一瓶 250 mL 的靜脈輸液，其包裝屬於 SVP 還是 LVP？這個分類有何實際意義？
blocks.en: Is the packaging for a 250 mL intravenous infusion bottle an SVP or an LVP? What is the practical significance of this classification?

blocks.zh: 某 API 需要防潮，應選擇哪種類型的容器？如果還需要避光，又需要什麼附加要求？
blocks.en: An API needs protection from moisture. Which type of container should be chosen? What additional requirement applies if it also needs protection from light?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在無菌製造（aseptic fill-finish）中，初級包裝（玻璃瓶、橡膠塞）的選擇直接影響產品穩定性。例如：選擇 Type I 硼矽酸鹽玻璃（符合 〈660〉）作為注射液容器，橡膠塞需通過 〈381〉 彈性體相容性測試。這些要求均源自 〈659〉 的基本框架。
blocks.en: In aseptic fill-finish, the choice of primary packaging (glass vials, rubber stoppers) directly affects product stability. For example, Type I borosilicate glass (meeting <660>) may be selected as the injection container, and the rubber stopper must pass the <381> elastomeric component compatibility tests. All of these requirements derive from the basic framework of <659>.

blocks.zh: Section 4: Injection and Noninjection Packaging Systems Section 4: 注射用與非注射用包裝系統
blocks.en: Section 4: Injection and Noninjection Packaging Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 注射劑包裝分類
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Classification of Injection Packaging

blocks.zh: 注射劑包裝的核心差異在於抗菌要求與多次使用：
blocks.en: The core differences in injection packaging lie in the antimicrobial requirement and repeated use:

blocks.zh: Multiple-dose（多劑量）：必須通過抗菌有效性測試（Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing），開封後效期 28 天（標籤另有說明除外），容量通常 ≤30 mL
blocks.en: Multiple-dose: must pass Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing, has a 28-day period of use after opening (unless the label states otherwise), and usually has a volume of ≤30 mL

blocks.zh: Single-dose（單劑量）：不需抗菌有效性測試，只用一次，開封後剩餘部分必須丟棄，容量上限為 1L（含特殊豁免情形）
blocks.en: Single-dose: Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing is not required; it is used only once, any remainder after opening must be discarded, and the volume limit is 1 L (with specific exemptions)

blocks.zh: Pharmacy bulk package：含多個單劑量，但僅限藥房配製使用，密封只穿刺一次，豁免 30 mL 限制
blocks.en: Pharmacy bulk package: contains multiple single doses but is restricted to pharmacy compounding use; the closure is penetrated only once; exempt from the 30 mL limit

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 非注射劑分類
blocks.en: Analogy: Classification of Noninjection Packaging

blocks.zh: 把非注射劑容器類型比喻成食品包裝：
blocks.en: Compare the noninjection container types to food packaging:

blocks.zh: Multiple-unit：一大罐餅乾——可多次取用，不影響剩餘品質
blocks.en: Multiple-unit: a large jar of cookies, which can be taken from repeatedly without affecting the quality of the rest

blocks.zh: Single-unit：一包糖果的個別包裝——開了就全部用掉
blocks.en: Single-unit: an individually wrapped candy, which is opened and used up entirely

blocks.zh: Unit-dose：藥局分裝的單次藥包——非腸外給藥路徑的單一劑量
blocks.en: Unit-dose: a single-use pack prepared by the pharmacy, a single dose for a route of administration other than parenteral

blocks.zh: Unit-of-use：預先計好用量的藥瓶——藥師直接發給患者，不再分裝（禁止再次分裝出售）
blocks.en: Unit-of-use: a bottle with a pre-counted quantity, dispensed by the pharmacist directly to the patient without repackaging (repackaging for sale is prohibited)

blocks.zh: Multiple-dose 28天規則：這是 USP 的預設規定，廠商可在標籤上指定不同時間（更短或更長，需有數據支持）。開封後的多劑量容器若超過 28 天未使用完畢，即使外觀正常也必須丟棄。
blocks.en: The 28-day rule for multiple-dose containers: this is the USP default, and the manufacturer may specify a different period on the label (shorter or longer, supported by data). If a multiple-dose container is not used up within 28 days of opening, it must be discarded even if it looks normal.

blocks.zh: Unit-of-use 禁止再分裝：此規定保護原廠包裝的完整性，確保患者獲得正確劑量。藥師不得將 unit-of-use 容器拆包再分裝出售。
blocks.en: No repackaging of unit-of-use containers: this requirement protects the integrity of the original packaging and ensures that the patient receives the correct dose. Pharmacists may not open a unit-of-use container and repackage its contents for sale.

blocks.zh: 某無菌注射用肝素鈉溶液，開封後在 ICU 使用，第 25 天尚有剩餘。依 USP 規定應如何處理？
blocks.en: A sterile heparin sodium injection is used in an ICU after opening, and some remains on day 25. How should it be handled under USP?

blocks.zh: Pharmacy bulk package 與 Multiple-dose container 的最大差異是什麼？在哪種情境下使用各自的類型？
blocks.en: What is the biggest difference between a pharmacy bulk package and a multiple-dose container? In which situations is each type used?

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填生產中，選擇 Single-dose vs. Multiple-dose 包裝系統對製程設計有重大影響：Multiple-dose 產品需要添加抑菌劑（如 benzyl alcohol、thimerosal），並需完成 〈51〉 抗菌有效性測試（Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing）。這個決策在新產品開發初期就必須確定。
blocks.en: In aseptic filling, the choice between a single-dose and a multiple-dose packaging system has a major impact on process design: a multiple-dose product needs an added antimicrobial preservative (such as benzyl alcohol or thimerosal) and must complete <51> Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing. This decision must be made at the very beginning of new product development.

blocks.zh: Section 5: Injection Packaging Requirements & Associated Components Section 5: 注射用包裝需求與相關元件
blocks.en: Section 5: Injection Packaging Requirements & Associated Components

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 注射劑容量規定
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Volume Limits for Injections

blocks.zh: 注射劑包裝的容量限制體現了「患者安全」設計：
blocks.en: The volume limits for injection packaging reflect a "patient safety" design:

blocks.zh: Single-dose 最大容量 1L：防止誤將大容量製劑全部一次給藥
blocks.en: Single-dose maximum volume of 1 L: prevents a large-volume preparation from being given in full in one administration by mistake

blocks.zh: Multiple-dose 最大容量 30 mL：限制多劑量取用次數，降低污染風險
blocks.en: Multiple-dose maximum volume of 30 mL: limits the number of withdrawals from a multiple-dose container and reduces the risk of contamination

blocks.zh: 脊髓/硬膜外給藥：必須用 Single-dose，安全等級最高
blocks.en: Intraspinal/epidural administration: must use single-dose containers, the highest level of safety

blocks.zh: 豁免情形：灌洗液、腹膜透析液、連續性血液濾過用補充液，因治療需要可超過 1L
blocks.en: Exemptions: irrigation solutions, peritoneal dialysis solutions and hemofiltration replacement solutions may exceed 1 L for therapeutic reasons

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 附件量具的精確度
blocks.en: Analogy: Accuracy of Associated Dosing Devices

blocks.zh: 藥品量杯就像烹飪的量匙——必須準確才能保證療效。USP 要求量具誤差 NMT 10%，意味著 10 mL 的劑量誤差不能超過 ±1 mL。只允許一種刻度，防止患者看錯單位（如把 mL 看成 tsp）。
blocks.en: A dosing cup is like a measuring spoon in cooking: it must be accurate to ensure efficacy. USP requires a measurement error of NMT 10%, which means that for a 10 mL dose the error may not exceed ±1 mL. Only one scale is permitted, to prevent patients from misreading units (for example, mistaking mL for tsp).

blocks.zh: CCI 測試義務：所有注射劑包裝必須驗證容器密封完整性（Container Closure Integrity, CCI），依 〈1207〉 系列章節選擇適當的測試方法（洩漏測試、密封品質測試等）。CCI 是 ICH Q6A、FDA 無菌指引、PIC/S Annex 1 的共同要求。
blocks.en: CCI testing obligation: all injection packaging must be verified for container closure integrity (CCI), and appropriate test methods (leak testing, seal quality testing, etc.) are selected in accordance with the <1207> series of chapters. CCI is a shared requirement of ICH Q6A, FDA's aseptic processing guidance and PIC/S Annex 1.

blocks.zh: Associated component 標示規定：刻度必須以公制單位（mL）標示，不能有兩種單位（如同時有 mL 和 tsp），這是 2020 年後 FDA 強制推行的兒科安全措施。
blocks.en: Labeling requirements for associated components: the graduations must be in metric units (mL), and two units (for example, both mL and tsp) are not permitted. This is a pediatric safety measure that FDA has enforced since 2020.

blocks.zh: 某生產商想製造 2L 的靜脈輸注葡萄糖注射液（用於 TPN 靜脈營養），是否符合 USP 的容量限制？
blocks.en: A manufacturer wants to produce a 2 L intravenous dextrose injection (for TPN parenteral nutrition). Does this comply with the USP volume limits?

blocks.zh: 某兒科口服混懸液附贈量杯，刻度有 mL 和湯匙（tsp）兩種。這是否符合 USP 〈659〉 的規定？
blocks.en: A pediatric oral suspension is supplied with a dosing cup marked with both mL and tablespoon (tsp) graduations. Does this comply with USP <659>?

blocks.zh: Section 6: Temperature and Storage Definitions Section 6: 溫度與儲存定義
blocks.en: Section 6: Temperature and Storage Definitions

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 MKT — Mean Kinetic Temperature
blocks.en: Formulas and Calculations: MKT (Mean Kinetic Temperature)

blocks.zh:
受控室溫（Controlled Room Temperature）MKT 偏差條件：
1. MKT ≤ 25°C（77°F）
2. 偏差溫度：15°C–30°C（59°F–86°F）
3. 瞬間最高溫：NMT 40°C（104°F）
4. 偏差時間：NMT 24 小時

受控冷溫（Controlled Cold Temperature）：
• 主要條件：2°C–8°C
• 允許偏差：2°C–15°C（<24 小時，僅一次）
• 計算 MKT ≤ 8°C（46°F）
• 不得低於 2°C 或高於 15°C

乾燥場所（Dry Place）：
• 平均相對濕度 ≤ 40% RH at 20°C
• 最高允許值 45% RH（前提：平均≤40%）
• 需至少 12 次等間距測量（一季、一年或儲存期）
blocks.en:
Controlled room temperature MKT excursion conditions:
1. MKT ≤ 25°C (77°F)
2. Excursion temperature: 15°C–30°C (59°F–86°F)
3. Transient maximum temperature: NMT 40°C (104°F)
4. Excursion duration: NMT 24 hours

Controlled cold temperature:
• Main condition: 2°C–8°C
• Permitted excursion: 2°C–15°C (<24 hours, one time only)
• Calculated MKT ≤ 8°C (46°F)
• Must not fall below 2°C or exceed 15°C

Dry place:
• Average relative humidity ≤ 40% RH at 20°C
• Maximum permitted value 45% RH (provided the average is ≤40%)
• At least 12 equally spaced measurements are required (over one season, one year or the storage period)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — MKT 的意義
blocks.en: Analogy: What MKT Means

blocks.zh: MKT（平均動力溫度）就像計算一段旅程的「等效溫度影響」——不是簡單平均，而是依阿瑞尼烏斯（Arrhenius）方程式加權計算。若一個產品在 25°C 儲存 23 小時，途中曾到達 35°C 達 1 小時，MKT 計算後若≤25°C，則符合受控室溫要求。這反映了藥品降解是化學反應，對溫度的響應是指數而非線性的。
blocks.en: MKT (mean kinetic temperature) is like calculating the "equivalent thermal effect" of a journey. It is not a simple average but is weighted according to the Arrhenius equation. If a product is stored at 25°C for 23 hours and reaches 35°C for 1 hour along the way, it meets the controlled room temperature requirement if the calculated MKT is ≤25°C. This reflects the fact that drug degradation is a chemical reaction, whose response to temperature is exponential rather than linear.

blocks.zh: 「Do not refrigerate」的重要性：某些藥品（如某些注射懸液、含乙醇製劑）在冷藏溫度下反而會析出沉澱或分相。標籤必須明確標示「勿冷藏」，以防止貯存或配發錯誤。
blocks.en: Why "Do not refrigerate" matters: some drug products (such as certain injectable suspensions and ethanol-containing preparations) may precipitate or phase-separate at refrigerated temperatures. The label must state "Do not refrigerate" explicitly to prevent storage or dispensing errors.

blocks.zh: 「Protect from freezing」的情境：水性注射劑若結冰，玻璃瓶可能破裂，或蛋白質生物製劑因冰晶形成而變性失活。冷藏鏈運輸尤其要注意「防凍」，這在冬季跨國物流中是常見的品質問題。
blocks.en: The "Protect from freezing" scenario: if an aqueous injection freezes, the glass container may break, or a protein biologic may be denatured and inactivated by ice crystal formation. Cold chain transport needs particular care to prevent freezing, a common quality problem in international winter logistics.

blocks.zh: Dry place 定義的嚴謹性：需要至少 12 次等間距測量，覆蓋一個季節或全年。偶發性高濕（最高 45% RH）是被允許的，重要的是平均值不超過 40% RH。
blocks.en: The rigor of the dry place definition: at least 12 equally spaced measurements covering a season or a full year are required. Occasional high humidity (up to 45% RH) is permitted; what matters is that the average does not exceed 40% RH.

blocks.zh: 某疫苗的推薦貯存條件為 2°C–8°C，在空運過程中曾有一次記錄顯示溫度達到 12°C 持續 18 小時，MKT 計算後為 7.5°C。這批產品是否符合「Controlled cold temperature」的要求？
blocks.en: A vaccine has a recommended storage condition of 2°C–8°C. During air transport, one record showed the temperature reached 12°C for 18 hours, and the calculated MKT was 7.5°C. Does this batch meet the "controlled cold temperature" requirement?

blocks.zh: 某口服液標籤寫「貯存於室溫（room temperature）」，倉庫夏天最高溫達 38°C。是否符合要求？若改寫為「Controlled room temperature」有何不同？
blocks.en: An oral solution is labeled "store at room temperature", and the warehouse reaches a maximum of 38°C in summer. Does this comply? What would be different if the label said "controlled room temperature"?

blocks.zh: 某廠商打算評估倉庫是否符合「乾燥場所（Dry place）」定義，一年內監控了 8 次相對濕度，平均 38% RH。這個監控計畫是否符合 USP 要求？
blocks.en: A manufacturer wants to assess whether its warehouse meets the "dry place" definition. It monitored relative humidity 8 times over one year, with an average of 38% RH. Does this monitoring plan meet USP requirements?

blocks.zh: 在藥廠倉儲管理中，USP 的溫度定義是設定倉庫溫度監控警報值的依據。例如：冷藏倉庫（2°C–8°C）的警報上限通常設在 10°C（留有緩衝），確保有足夠時間在超過 15°C 前採取行動，以符合 Controlled cold temperature 的偏差規定。這些定義也直接影響穩定性測試設計（ICH Q1A 的加速、中間和長期條件）。
blocks.en: In pharmaceutical warehouse management, the USP temperature definitions are the basis for setting temperature monitoring alarm limits. For example, the upper alarm limit for a cold storage room (2°C–8°C) is usually set at 10°C (leaving a buffer) so that there is enough time to act before 15°C is exceeded, in order to comply with the excursion provisions for controlled cold temperature. These definitions also directly affect stability study design (the accelerated, intermediate and long-term conditions of ICH Q1A).

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 包裝材料基本要求：不得損害藥品的 Safety, Identity, Strength, Quality, Purity（SIQOP），需符合 〈660〉、〈661〉、〈670〉、〈381〉 等子章節
blocks.en: Basic requirements for packaging materials: must not impair the drug product's safety, identity, strength, quality or purity (SIQOP), and must meet related chapters such as <660>, <661>, <670> and <381>

blocks.zh: 包裝層級：Primary（直接接觸）→ Secondary（接觸初級）→ Tertiary（接觸次級）→ Ancillary（物流輔助）→ Associated（給藥附件）
blocks.en: Packaging hierarchy: Primary (direct contact) → Secondary (contacts primary) → Tertiary (contacts secondary) → Ancillary (logistics support) → Associated (administration accessories)

blocks.zh: 容器防護等級：Hermetic（全氣密）> Tight（防液/固/蒸氣）> Well-closed（防固體）；Light-resistant（遮光）為獨立屬性
blocks.en: Container protection levels: Hermetic (fully airtight) > Tight (protects against liquids/solids/vapors) > Well-closed (protects against solids); Light-resistant is an independent attribute

blocks.zh: 注射劑分類：Single-dose（單次、無抗菌測試要求）vs. Multiple-dose（多次、需抗菌測試、≤30 mL、開封後 28 天）vs. Pharmacy bulk package（多劑量、只穿刺一次、藥房配製專用）
blocks.en: Injection classification: Single-dose (single use, no antimicrobial testing required) vs. Multiple-dose (repeated use, antimicrobial testing required, ≤30 mL, 28 days after opening) vs. Pharmacy bulk package (multiple doses, single penetration, for pharmacy compounding only)

blocks.zh: 非注射劑分類：Multiple-unit（多次取用）、Single-unit（單次使用）、Unit-dose（非腸外單劑量）、Unit-of-use（預計量、禁止再分裝）
blocks.en: Noninjection classification: Multiple-unit (repeated withdrawal), Single-unit (single use), Unit-dose (nonparenteral single dose), Unit-of-use (pre-counted quantity, no repackaging)

blocks.zh: 溫度定義：Freezer（−25° 至 −10°）、Refrigerator（2° 至 8°）、Cool（8° 至 15°）、Controlled RT（20° 至 25°）、Warm（30° 至 40°）、Excessive heat（>40°）
blocks.en: Temperature definitions: Freezer (−25° to −10°), Refrigerator (2° to 8°), Cool (8° to 15°), Controlled RT (20° to 25°), Warm (30° to 40°), Excessive heat (>40°)

blocks.zh: MKT 應用：受控室溫偏差條件（NMT 25°C，15°–30°C，NMT 24h，不超過 40°C）；受控冷溫偏差（2°–15°C，NMT 24h，僅一次）
blocks.en: MKT application: controlled room temperature excursion conditions (NMT 25°C, 15°–30°C, NMT 24 h, not above 40°C); controlled cold temperature excursion (2°–15°C, NMT 24 h, one time only)

blocks.zh: 乾燥場所：平均 RH ≤40%（最高可達 45% RH），需≥12 次等間距測量
blocks.en: Dry place: average RH ≤40% (up to 45% RH permitted), with ≥12 equally spaced measurements

blocks.zh: USP 〈659〉: Packaging and Storage Requirements | 包裝與貯存要求
blocks.en: USP <659>: Packaging and Storage Requirements
